title: Does the chat-v2 spec define an undo or restore operation?
prompt:
Does the chat-v2 spec define an undo or restore operation?

Answer from this repository: its docs, specs, rules and code. Search and read; edit no files. End with the answer in a few sentences and name the file it comes from. When the docs hold an older and a newer answer, give the current one. If the repository doesn't answer the question, say it isn't documented.
